title: Adult with acute abdominal pain
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a patient with acute abdominal pain: cover location, onset, associated symptoms, and surgical history.
opening: Hi. My stomach has been hurting since last night and I cannot sleep.

disclosures.response: The pain is mostly in the lower right side of my abdomen. It has been aching for about twelve hours.
It started as a dull ache but has gotten sharper over the last few hours.
I have not eaten since yesterday afternoon. I feel nauseous but have not vomited.
I felt a little warm this morning but I do not have a thermometer to check.
My bowel movements have been normal. No diarrhea or blood.
I had my appendix removed when I was fifteen. I take no regular medications and have no drug allergies.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission or rapport.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before proceeding.

metrics.name: Symptom characterization
metrics.rationale: Explores onset, location, character, or severity.
metrics.coaching_hint: Characterize the pain: 'Where does it hurt, and when did it start?'

metrics.name: Associated symptoms
metrics.rationale: Checks for nausea, vomiting, fever, appetite changes, and bowel changes.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about associated symptoms: 'Any nausea, vomiting, fever, or changes in appetite or bowels?'

metrics.name: Medical and surgical history
metrics.rationale: Checks prior surgical history, medications, and allergies.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about history: 'Have you had any surgeries, and do you take any medications?'

metrics.name: Safety escalation
metrics.rationale: Recognizes the possibility of a surgical abdomen and the need for urgent evaluation.
metrics.coaching_hint: Address urgency: 'Could this be a surgical abdomen — should we arrange urgent evaluation now?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the plan and check understanding before ending.
